title: Copilot Studio: makers can require human approval before an agent runs a tool
notes: claim 52: severity major on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts and existing control references check out, and searches did not locate documentation for the new toggle or central enforcement. The risk rationale should drop its unsupported assurance about new data access, and the distinction between instructions and enforcement needs a supporting citation.
